name: Housecall Pro

tiers.how: Housecall Pro offers a REST API (API key authentication). The owner must locate their API key in Housecall Pro account settings and store it via setup_creds. Documented coverage includes customers, jobs, and estimates for reads; write coverage varies — verify each endpoint against the current API docs before relying on it.
always_tap: any invoice send to a client
any job dispatch to a technician

tiers.how: For operations not covered by the API, Sage drives Housecall Pro in a signed-in Playwright browser. The owner must keep the browser profile logged in. This path may break with UI updates and should be treated as a fallback only.
reads: anything visible in the Housecall Pro web UI
writes: any action available in the web UI

gotchas: Housecall Pro's public API has limited documentation; verify endpoint coverage before planning any integration.
Housecall Pro is optimised for mobile field technicians; some features may lag on the web UI.
Do not confuse with Jobber; both target field-service businesses but Housecall Pro's API maturity differs.
API access may require a specific Housecall Pro subscription tier; check with support.
notes: Housecall Pro is a mobile-first field-service platform; verify API endpoint coverage carefully before building integrations beyond basic reads.
